title: sharing-server: Principal name/description localizable; ShareNotification name stays base
description:
jmap-sharing-server (with sharing-types): Principal `name` and `description` are localizable.
- name: not nullable. description: nullable.
- ShareNotification `name` (RFC 9670 3) is NOT localizable; fill it with the base value.
Also check the Principal /query name filter against the text-handling child: compare with the sort collation.
notes: From .5: same /query wiring as .7 for Principal/query and /queryChanges (name filter and sort).
